visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman in pink pajamas is sleeping soundly in a cozy bed under a beige duvet. The room is dimly lit, suggesting early morning. A smartphone rests on the bedsheet beside her. (2) She wakes up, stretches her arms, and relaxes in bed while watching a movie projected onto a large white wall in the bedroom. (3) The scene shifts to a laundry area where she is putting pink clothes into a sleek, black stacked washer-dryer unit. (4) She is seen in a kitchen pantry selecting snacks, then happily eating chips and drinking from a large cup while sitting on a light gray sofa. (5) Back at the laundry tower, she removes a fresh, folded pink garment and smells it with a satisfied expression. (6) She is then shown organizing her wardrobe, hanging clothes, and neatly arranging colorful socks in a drawer. (7) She returns to the sofa, lying down under a red blanket with heart patterns to rest again. (8) A hand enters the frame and gently shakes her awake from her nap on the sofa. (9) She stands in the laundry room next to the black appliance, gesturing towards its features while speaking directly to the camera with high energy. (10) She holds up her smartphone to display an app interface, then smiles and waves goodbye before walking away from the laundry unit.
